description: This file defines a transform function for processing polygon data in a deck.gl layer, including parsing polygon coordinates from various formats, handling elevation and metrics, and preparing features for visualization.

classes.name: PolygonFeature
classes.description: Interface representing a polygon feature with optional polygon coordinates, name, elevation, extra properties, and metrics.

methods.name: parseElevationValue
methods.description: Parses a string value into a float number, returns undefined if parsing fails.

methods.name: processPolygonData
methods.description: Processes an array of data records into polygon features, parsing coordinates based on line type, handling elevation and metrics.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main exported function that transforms chart properties into a format suitable for rendering, utilizing processPolygonData.
